request.subject: UNIT:GOBLIN:PATROL_BOAT

layers.text: Change only one thing: erase the white and blue water, waves and foam under the hull, so the boat floats alone on a transparent background with nothing under it. Do not redraw anything else: keep the hull, the tin patches, the sail with its yellow patch, the firework rocket, the goblin, the colours, thick black outline and art style exactly the same.
